title: An Empty Car
summary: Every hero gave their life to bind the Crooked Queen. The train comes for their tickets and leaves with no one aboard.

epilogue.title: The Last Act
epilogue.text: Not one of you walked away from the goat skull, and the Crooked Queen is bound because of it.

epilogue.title: The Last Ride
epilogue.text: The Ghostlight Express pulls in at the edge of the ash, waits the longest minute it's ever waited, and pulls out again with every seat empty.
